text:
- **Codex parity:** A Codex session now gets the same pm guarantees as a Claude Code session. The owner-request judge and day summary run on Codex, and a pm command warns when Codex hooks did not run.
- **Release shipped:** A new pm release shipped with the Codex work, with an install script and macOS and Linux builds. A release policy design page now recommends releasing on each merge.
- **Design and code gates:** A change to covered code waits at review and sprint close until its design page is updated or waived. Command code now splits by noun, and old parser compatibility code is removed.
